verdict.rationale: Cactus lets users keep data on their own hardware: models run on-device with "no data leaving the device," and LoRA fine-tuning can run locally with your own hardware and data. That is a de facto local-vs-hosted residency choice. However, nothing documents region or residency selection for the hosted platform (uploads, generations, hosted GPU training), and the cloud-routing feature has no stated location controls. Missing for 10: region selection for hosted storage and training, documented data-residency guarantees for uploaded data, residency controls on cloud routing, independent corroboration.
